items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: And on the tape, it’s like a song and dance and play routine. He comes out, he sings the song, he does a little tap dancing with a big arrangement that they had done for “The Steve Allen Show,”

ctx.x: Well what a great thing for a drummer to start with.

And he could sing too. And on the tape, it’s like a song and dance and play routine. He comes out, he sings the song, he does a little tap dancing with a big arrangement that they had done for “The Steve Allen Show,” and then he sings some more, and then he suddenly winds up on drums and plays this tremendous shout chorus with the band and © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
then this tremendous solo, and then he stands up and he says, “That was nothing,” and for him it was.
